chunks: He said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh reported to me from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hurayz, from Zurarah ibn A'yan, who reported from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them all).

He said: "The pinnacle of the matter, its summit, its key, the gateway to all things, and the pleasure of the Most Merciful, Exalted is He, lie in obedience to the Imam after recognizing him." Then he said: "Indeed, Allah, Most High, says:
"Whoever obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah, and whoever turns away — We have not sent you as a keeper over them."

key_terms.الإِمَام: al-Imam - The divinely appointed leader and guide of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.طَاعَة: Ta'ah - Obedience: willing submission to divinely appointed authority
key_terms.مَعْرِفَة: Ma'rifah - Recognition/knowledge: deep spiritual knowledge and acknowledgment of the Imam's authority

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the importance of obedience to the Imam and its connection to obeying Allah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) teaches that the pinnacle, summit, key, gateway to all affairs, and the pleasure of the Most Merciful God lies in obedience to the Imam after recognizing him. He then cites Quran 4:80 to connect obedience to the Imam with obedience to the Prophet and ultimately to Allah. This hadith establishes the theological foundation of Imamate, directly linking spiritual authority to divine mandate.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: "Abul Qasim Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Qawlawayh reported to me from Muhammad ibn Yaqoob al-Kulayni, from ‘Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa from Huraiz, from Zurarah ibn A’ayan, who reported that: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them all) said: "The most important matter, the best, the key, the entrance to all affairs and the pleasure of the Gracious Lord lie in obedience to the Imam after have recognized him."
Then he said: Allah, Most High, says (in the Qur’an):
"whoever obeys the messenger, has obeyed Allah. But, whoever turns away: ’We have not sent you (Muhammad) as a keeper over them.’ (Al-Nisa, 4: 80)"
